A8 round 2 is complete. Report appended to `research/audit/wave5-alpha.md`.

## What I found

**The dispatch handed me 25 rejections; disk holds 39.** Recomputing from `wave5-judge.jsonl` (last verdict per `(id, model)`, minus the 63 round-1 keys): 418 current paired verdicts, 66 rejects, **0 nulls** — so paired coverage really is 209/209 and your round-1 blocker is closed. But 14 unadjudicated rejections were missing from the list, mostly the Euclidean/ℝⁿ batch. That mattered: the one fatal was rejected by **both** lanes and only the Sonnet row was handed to me.

## Outcome — 39 rows

| outcome | rows |
|---|---|
| `confirmed_nonfatal` | 35 |
| `confirmed_fatal` | **2** (one item, both lanes) |
| `false_positive` | 2 |

**The fatal: `cor-monotone-converges-iff-bounded`.** Its Remark said "Without boundedness the forward direction is what fails" — but the forward direction is *converges ⇒ bounded*, which never fails, and the item's own Statement says so explicitly three paragraphs above. The offered witness (a nondecreasing unbounded sequence) doesn't converge, so it can't witness a failed implication. Both lanes caught it independently. Repaired to say the true thing; certified **CERTIFY, 0 fatal** by an independent read-only Sonnet lane, which I did not author. Stamp written, `verification.audited` not.

**Two DeepSeek false positives**, both refuted with verbatim text: `fs-rationals-complete` *does* carry the sₙ construction DeepSeek said it lacks, and `def-euclidean-spheres-and-closed-balls` *does* pin ‖·‖₂ down via its own stated identity plus `lem-metrics-on-rn`'s explicit formula.

Worth putting in A10: a **Remark-only** repair that `impact-audit` confirms changes zero public interfaces still invalidated 31 frozen contexts, 30 of them items I never opened.
